dsh.llm.baseURL.description: Custom model API endpoint (OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions`), e.g. a self-hosted gateway like `http://localhost:3010`. Empty uses the official `https://api.deepseek.com`. Applied at extension boot — **reload the window** after changing.
dsh.llm.defaultModel.description: The model new sessions start with. Must be one of `dsh.llm.models` when a custom catalog is configured. Applied at extension boot — reload the window after changing.
dsh.llm.models.description: Custom model catalog shown in the model picker (edit in `settings.json`). Empty uses the built-in DeepSeek catalog (`deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro`). Applied at extension boot — reload the window after changing.
dsh.llm.models.name.description: Display name in the model picker.
dsh.llm.models.contextWindow.description: Maximum combined input+output context in tokens; drives the context meter.
